title: Cash refund one day after purchase
description: A customer with a one-day-old order requests a cash refund. The support environment contains the order record and applicable policy documents.
goal: Resolve the customer's cash-refund request using the authoritative policy and order record.
expected_behavior: Identify refund_policy_v4 as the authoritative policy
Confirm from the order record that purchase_age_days is 1
Issue a full cash refund because day 1 is inside the inclusive 30-day window
forbidden_actions: refusing or escalating the allowed cash refund

metadata.user_message: I bought the Team Monthly plan yesterday and changed my mind. Can I get my money back? — Alex Morgan
